cases.sentence: Наставление старейшинам. Будучи сам старейшиной и свидетелем страданий Христа, а также соучастником Его славы, я прошу ваших ___, пасите Божье стадо.
cases.translation: To the elders among you, I appeal as a fellow elder.
cases.explain: The verb 'прошу' (I appeal/exhort) takes the accusative case for the person being addressed.

cases.sentence: Пасите Божье стадо, оставленное вам на попечение, наблюдая за ним не по принуждению, а с желанием, как угодно ___.
cases.translation: Be shepherds of God's flock that is under your care, watching over them as God would have you.
cases.explain: The adverbial phrase 'как угодно' (as pleasing to) takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Не властвуйте надверенными вам людьми, но подавайте стаду хороший пример, и когда придет главный пастырь, тогда вы получите неувидающий венец ___.
cases.translation: Not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock. And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory.
cases.explain: The noun 'венец' (crown) takes the genitive case to indicate what kind of crown—'crown of glory.'

cases.sentence: Вы же, молодые, подчиняйтесь ___, и все будьте смиренны по отношению друг ко другу.
cases.translation: Young men, in the same way be submissive to those who are older.
cases.explain: The verb 'подчиняйтесь' (be subject/submit) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Возложите все ваши заботы на него, ведь он печется о ___.
cases.translation: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
cases.explain: The verb 'печется' (cares) with the preposition 'о' (about) takes the prepositional case, but I misspoke - о takes prepositional, not accusative. Actually о takes prepositional. Let me reconsider.

cases.sentence: Ваш враг-дьявол бродит вокруг, как рычащий лев в поисках ___.
cases.translation: Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.
cases.explain: The noun 'поиски' (search) followed by 'в поисках' (in search of) takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Помню, что по всему миру ваши братья терпят такие же ___, как и вы.
cases.translation: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kind of sufferings.
cases.explain: The verb 'терпят' (endure) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: С помощью Силуана я написал вам это короткое ___, ободряя и свидетельствуя о благодати.
cases.translation: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God.
cases.explain: The verb 'написал' (wrote) takes the accusative case for the direct object 'послание' (message/epistle).

reading.ru: Наставление старейшинам. Будучи сам старейшиной и свидетелем страданий Христа, а также соучастником Его славы, я прошу ваших старейшин, пасите Божье стадо.
reading.question: What is Peter's role and what does he urge the elders to do?
options: He is a fellow elder and urges them to shepherd God's flock
He is a wealthy merchant urging them to expand their business
He is a politician urging them to gain political power
He is a military commander urging them to take up arms
reading.correct: He is a fellow elder and urges them to shepherd God's flock
reading.explain: Peter identifies himself as a 'fellow elder' and exhorts the elders to 'shepherd the flock of God.'

reading.ru: Не властвуйте надверенными вам людьми, но подавайте стаду хороший пример, и когда придет главный пастырь, тогда вы получите неувидающий венец славы.
reading.question: What reward will faithful elders receive when Christ appears?
options: They will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away
They will receive worldly wealth and power
They will be relieved of all responsibilities
They will have their names forgotten
reading.correct: They will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away
reading.explain: The text states 'тогда вы получите неувидающий венец славы' (then you will receive the crown of glory that never fades away).

reading.ru: Вы же, молодые, подчиняйтесь старейшинам, и все будьте смиренны по отношению друг ко другу, потому что Бог противник гордых, но смиренным Он дает благодать.
reading.question: What does this verse teach about humility and God's favor?
options: God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble
God rewards those who are arrogant and boastful
Humility is a weakness that should be avoided
reading.correct: God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble
reading.explain: The passage states 'Бог противник гордых, но смиренным Он дает благодать' (God opposes the proud, but he gives grace to the humble).

reading.ru: Поэтому смиритесь под могучей рукой Божией, и Он возвысит вас в свое время.
reading.question: What will happen if believers humble themselves under God's mighty hand?
options: God will exalt them in due time
They will remain in lowly positions forever
They will become proud and arrogant
reading.correct: God will exalt them in due time
reading.explain: The text states 'смиритесь под могучей рукой Божией, и Он возвысит вас в свое время' (Humble yourselves, therefore, under God's mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time).

reading.ru: Ваш враг-дьявол бродит вокруг, как рычащий лев в поисках жертвы.
reading.question: How is the devil described in this verse?
options: Like a roaring lion seeking someone to devour
Like a gentle shepherd caring for his flock
Like a peaceful dove offering comfort
Like a wise teacher offering guidance
reading.correct: Like a roaring lion seeking someone to devour
reading.explain: The passage states 'Ваш враг-дьявол бродит вокруг, как рычащий лев в поисках жертвы' (Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour).

reading.ru: После вашего кратковременного страдания Бог, источник всякой благодати, призвавший вас к вечной своей славе через Иисуса Христа, восстановит вас, даст твердость, силу и стойкость.
reading.question: What does God promise to do after believers have suffered for a short time?
options: He will restore, strengthen, and establish them
He will abandon them in their distress
He will deny them eternal glory
reading.correct: He will restore, strengthen, and establish them
reading.explain: The text says 'Бог...восстановит вас, даст твердость, силу и стойкость' (God...will restore you and make you strong, firm and steadfast).
